llm_response.reason: The website displays hallmark signs of investment scams: it promises impossibly high returns (up to 80%), uses heavy urgency and psychological tactics, requires deposits only via cryptocurrencies (which are untraceable and non-reversible), has ambiguous company details and an unprofessional email address, and claims a fake business history (domain is newly registered, yet states 10+ years in business). All these match established scam characteristics including guaranteed returns, upfront deposits, ambiguous privacy, and fake company identities.
